Postgraduate supervision

Students

My postgraduate supervision spans PhD, research, mixed-mode and taught-course programmes in computing. Current projects connect wireless and underwater sensor networks, mobile ad-hoc systems, indoor positioning, robotics and applied AI.

People · supervision network

Research grows
through people.

Current postgraduate work forms a connected supervision network across communication, sensing, positioning and intelligent systems.

01 / NETWORKS
Wireless systems

Routing, security and resilient communication.

02 / UNDERWATER
Sensing below the surface

Acoustic networks and Internet of Underwater Things.

03 / POSITIONING
Context and place

Indoor localisation using WiFi, cameras and hybrid methods.

04 / INTELLIGENCE
Robotics and applied AI

Motion planning, autonomy and intelligent applications.
